answer: Seats stay with people who can pay once, not farms that must pay a hundred times. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. The price of trying is an examination charge of £44, charged again each time a name fails, paid up front for every single name, while the jetty stays small. The jetty here is simple — no proof, no seat, and Pressed geometer gear warrant is the proof, because a warrant geometers carry after figure trials. The clerk notes dune. Every karst is counted once.
